why_dynamic: A downburst must show a thunderstorm downdraft/outflow signature over time; a static storm frame is insufficient.
collector_notes: New Commons own-work downburst video. Accept only if the footage shows decisive near-surface outflow or wind/rain burst dynamics rather than generic severe rain.

why_dynamic: A microburst must show localized downdraft/outflow behavior over time; a static storm frame is insufficient.
collector_notes: Commons microburst video lead from the Microbursts category. Accept only if visual evidence shows downburst/microburst dynamics, not just rain blown across a street.
